items.question: Which K-Pop dance styles are available?
items.answer: We offer K-Pop dance templates inspired by various choreography styles — from powerful, synchronized group moves to smooth solo performances. Templates are updated regularly with new styles.

items.question: Can I recreate specific K-Pop choreography?
items.answer: Our templates are inspired by popular K-Pop dance styles rather than exact copies of specific songs. They capture the energy and precision that K-Pop choreography is known for.

items.question: Is this good for fan content?
items.answer: Absolutely! K-Pop AI dance videos are perfect for fan accounts, fan edits, and community content. Many fans use these to create fun content featuring their bias or fan art.

items.question: Can I make a group dance video?
items.answer: The AI works best with single-subject photos. For group dance effects, create individual videos and combine them using a video editor, or use a group photo where one person is prominent.

items.question: What platforms work best for K-Pop dance content?
items.answer: TikTok, Twitter/X, and Instagram are the top platforms for K-Pop content. Our videos are generated in vertical 9:16 format, optimized for TikTok and Instagram Reels.
